name: VelaTrace
description: Checks a KiCad 10 board for small mistakes before you order it. Offline. Also routes small boards with preview, DRC check and undo. Alpha.
description_full:
VelaTrace is a free companion window for KiCad 10's PCB Editor. It is an alpha, tested on Windows only with KiCad 10.0.4 and 10.0.6. Try it on a copy of your board first.

Check design: a fast first pass over your board for small mistakes before you order it, such as an LED without a series resistor, I2C pull-up problems, duplicated ICs, 0 ohm shorts and unset values. Each finding comes with the evidence and a suggested fix. It is not a design review: on 12 boards it had never seen, 44% of the design-rule findings were judged correct, and the reviewers were LLM agents, not human engineers. It finds only a minority of the issues a reviewer would raise, so treat findings as hints.

JLCPCB window (opt-in): checks LCSC part numbers against the part's value, flags out-of-stock parts and exports JLCPCB BOM, placement and Gerber files. It has been tried on three boards so far.

Route board: routes the board with Vela-routing, VelaTrace's own router (Python and numpy, running inside the plugin; no Java or extra download). The result is previewed on User.9, then KiCad DRC checks it in the background. Approve writes the copper as one undoable commit after a backup. It routes only placed, unrouted small boards, with one track width and clearance for all nets. There are no differential pairs, length tuning or BGA fanout. Approve anyway applies a route that failed DRC, after a confirmation that lists the findings.

Free (MIT) and offline by default: network use is opt-in and listed in docs/privacy.md in the repository (optional AI provider calls with your own key, an optional JLCPCB parts download and live stock lookup, optional Groq search via Tavily).

During the install KiCad asks to enable the KiCad API: click Yes (or later: Preferences > Plugins > tick Enable KiCad API). First start: KiCad installs about 300 MB of Python packages (kicad-python, PySide6, numpy); the VelaTrace button appears when that is done, about 4 minutes in our test. No button? Preferences > Plugins, right-click VelaTrace, Recreate Plugin Environment.

For dense or high-speed routing see KiCadRoutingTools; for datasheet-aware design review see kicad-happy; for a mature JLCPCB part-assignment workflow see kicad-jlcpcb-tools.
